notes.title: Fall Of The Mafia Multiplayer
notes.content:
A new multiplayer update has been introduced to the Fall of the mafia game. However, there may be deficiencies in the multiplayer and continuous multiplayer and singleplayer updates will continue.
The changes that have been made:
* New maps
* New variety of weapons
* Multiplayer
* New music
* Character and camera control commands have been renewed.
* The difficulty level of the game has been balanced.
